annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı (Ministry of Industry and Technology, Türkiye)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets type-approval rules for automated driving systems (ADS) of fully autonomous M and N category vehicles
Covers defined-area transport, fixed-route services and automated parking systems
Defines ADS terms such as ODD, DDT, minimal risk manoeuvre, remote intervention operator
Technical specifications and assessment by approval authorities or technical services; EU-style type-approval certificate
Harmonises with EU Regulation 2022/1426; enters into force on publication
annotation.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology regulation, published 1 December 2024, on type approval of motor vehicles regarding the automated driving system of fully autonomous vehicles. It transposes EU Regulation 2022/1426, defining scope, terminology, approval procedures and technical assessment for ADS in M and N category vehicles.
annotation.title_clean: Tam Otonom Araçların Otonom Sürüş Sistemine İlişkin Motorlu Araçların Tip Onayı Hakkında Yönetmelik (AB/2022/1426)
annotation.title_en: Regulation on Type Approval of Motor Vehicles Regarding the Automated Driving System of Fully Autonomous Vehicles (EU/2022/1426)
annotation.venue: Resmî Gazete (Official Gazette of Türkiye), No. 32739
